content:
as a new player (2 weeks) that was around before the shop updated, this actually really annoys me. the addition of the gnosis at the same rate was an actual nice qol change, but this price hike is ridiculous (especially so for the advanced skill materials).

there's a benefit to having 1 whole item in the shop vs buying the shards (it makes the items more tangible since it's vastly easier to keep track of how many rose scrips you have than to keep track of how many aetheric shards & mimetic crystals you have in addition to the rose scrip cost of them), but this is honestly the wrong direction.

you do get more aetheric stones faster (3 in 1 month with the new shop vs 1 in 2 months with the old shop) so the price increase can at least be justified a little (except it punishes players that didn't mind waiting), but with advanced skill materials it's a 51.5% increase in price for all units just to have 1 more every single month (3 in 1 month with new shop vs 2 in 1 month with old shop).

this honestly just seems like a way to force people to buy the battle pass. this along with reading other posts in the forum about recent and past changes doesn't paint a good impression for me to becoming a long time player.

**the solution to the problem is simple in my opinion: just offer both options** (the cheaper aetheric shards and mimetic crystals along with the more expensive advanced skill materials and aetheric stones). that way you're still paying a premium for getting more faster, but the option to slowly accumulate them at a cheaper price exists and those players aren't punished.

content:
I was playing Alva in Rail mode when I noticed that the more Shield she has, the closer in damage her Strike and Precision Slash get to each other, which I found strange.

After testing and investigating the character, I realized that her Rouse effect and Soulforge effect do multiply with Base DMG% relics and her Dynamic Vision talent (and DMG Amp as far as I can tell), but her Precision Slash DMG increase effect does not scale with her talent, relics or any other source of Base DMG% and DMG Amp.

You can see this in the attached video where using a Helot Defend to gain 25 Shield only increases Precision Slash's displayed DMG by 50, showing that it is not factoring anything else in besides the pure shield. (The rest of the video is checking that various scalings do work properly, which is good. It is using a borrowed Alva UID 101118720 with about 320% personal Death Resistance stat.)

I checked the Chinese skill texts and asked someone fluent to help me make sure, and we saw that:

3 Cost:
造成 [攻击力×120%] 点伤害。每点护盾使伤害提高 2 点。在本回合中每打出 1 张「防御」，算力消耗 -1。视为「打击」。

Rouse:
艾尔瓦获得 50 点狂气。特殊-图标.png灵知觉醒：获得 [防御力×8%] 点戒备-图标.png戒备。艾尔瓦指令卡造成的伤害随当前护盾提高，每点护盾提高 2。特殊-图标.png保留。

Since the wording is the same and her Rouse & Soulforge do correctly multiply with Base DMG%, I think it is a bug that the +2 DMG per 1 Shield effect of Precision Slash is unaffected by any other stat (it is basically currently "working" as if it was a Strike with added STR = 2×Shield).


-

There is also a slight error with how Alva's Soulforge was translated into English. In Chinese it says;

「打击」和「心眼利刃」造成的基础伤害提高本回合自身获得护盾量的 50%。

Which does say that the base damage is increased based on the shield gained specifically by this character that turn, whereas in English it doesn't specify that - so it reads as if any character on the team providing Shield would increase it (which it doesn't).
thread_title: Alva 3 Cost "Precision Slash" +2 DMG per 1 Shield effect doesn't scale with anything
